title: gonatanthus pumilus
intro: Gonatanthus pumilus, commonly known as the Yellow Ginger or Dwarf Ginger, is a species of flowering plant in the Zingiberaceae family. It is a small, perennial herb with health benefits, particularly in treating digestive issues and nausea due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Gonatanthus pumilus include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents in this plant include gingerols and shogaols, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
